name: Youth On The Move (NGO)
description:
Youth On The Move is a youth-driven, nation-building NGO committed to creating real and lasting impact. Founded by passionate young individuals at just 17, the organization thrives on the selfless contributions of its members, who volunteer their time and donate from their own salaries.

We focus on sustainable solutions in education, youth engagement, women’s empowerment, and community development, ensuring transparency and accountability in every initiative. Our mission is to empower individuals, foster leadership, and inspire communities, proving that true change begins with dedication and action.

Join us in shaping a brighter future, where every effort counts and every contribution creates meaningful impact.

featured_reviews.name: vivek phulare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am truly impressed with the remarkable work being done by Youth on the Move NGO. Their dedication towards empowering communities, creating opportunities for young people, and driving meaningful social change is highly commendable. The team works with sincerity, passion, and vision, ensuring that every initiative has a real impact on the ground.

What stands out the most is their ability to connect with Youth at the grassroots level and bring positive transformation through education, awareness, and skill development. Their efforts not only uplift individuals but also inspire others to contribute towards building a better society.

I feel proud to be associated with such an inspiring organization and strongly recommend their initiatives to anyone who wishes to support genuine and impactful social work.

featured_reviews.name: Hasti Mavani
featured_reviews.review_text: Our visit to the school and hospital was a meaningful experience that helped us identify real problems faced by students, teachers, patients, and staff. By observing closely and interacting with people, we understood the challenges in learning, cleanliness, management, and overall environment. This entire activity was possible because of the energy and dedication of the youth on the move involved. Their willingness to step out, observe, and contribute made the work impactful. It was a valuable opportunity to learn, analyse, and think about practical solutions. Overall, the experience was positive, educational, and inspiring, and it encouraged us to work more for community improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: What I appreciate about Youth on the Move is their transparency and heart. Every project, from distributing ration kits to their environmental initiatives, is handled with absolute dedication. They are a forward-thinking NGO that truly understands how to mobilize the younger generation for social good.

featured_reviews.name: Zainab Dayatar
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm an Andheri based cat feeder. Arham ambulance has recently helped me treat 3 of my strays. Their ambulance arrives within minutes. Dr is good. U can avail their services when an animal is in urgent need. They don't charge a penny. The 2 problems I found were firstly hygiene. The table was not cleared before treating the next patient. As a result any animal is at risk of catching an infection. Secondly one trained assistant is required to catch hold of the strays brought. Otherwise, the service provided is good. Thank you AYSG for helping us help the strays.

महाराष्ट्र राज्य हे देशात असे एकमेव राज्य आहे जिथे एवढ्या मोठ्या संख्येत गडकिल्ले आहेत. राज्याच्या कोपऱ्या - कोपऱ्यात गडकिल्ले विखुरलेले आहेत आणि त्यांचा स्वतंत्र असा एक इतिहास आहे. आपल्या मराठी ऐतिहासिक संस्कृतीचे प्रतिक म्हणून या गडकिल्ल्यांना अनन्यसाधारण महत्व आहे पण ह्याच गडकिल्ल्यावर वाढलेले गवत-काटेरी झुडूप, पडलेल्या भिंती, ढासळत असलेले बुरुज, छप्पर नसलेली मंदिरे, दुर्गंधी सुटलेली तलावातील पाणी अक्षरशः कचराकुंडी झालेली आहे. ह्या सगळ्या गोष्टी लक्षात घेऊन एक सामाजिक बांधिलकी आणि शिवविचार पेटता राहण्यासाठी "शिवदुर्ग प्रतिष्ठाण - दुर्गसंवर्धन हाच एक ध्यास" ह्या संस्थेची स्थापना करण्यात आली आहे.

featured_reviews.name: Dhanlaxmi Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Humanity Global Foundation is a shining example of kindness in action.  Their dedication to education for underprivileged children, disaster relief, sustainability, tree plantation, beach cleanups, and support for orphanages and old age homes is truly commendable.

They work selflessly to uplift lives and protect our planet. Every contribution to this foundation helps bring hope and change where it’s needed most. Let’s support and stand with them in their beautiful mission to serve humanity!

I really appreciate their commitment to humanitarian values and the way they create real impact on the ground. They not only provide immediate support but also work towards long-term sustainable solutions, empowering people to build better lives.
Highly recommend supporting their initiatives — every effort here goes a long way in making the world a better place. 🙏❤️

featured_reviews.name: Nikita Vartak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very positive experience with HGF NGO Job Cell. Their team is professional, supportive, and truly dedicated to connecting candidates with the right opportunities in the NGO and development sector. The process was smooth and transparent, and I really appreciate the guidance they provided at every stage.

They not only share relevant job openings but also ensure that the roles align with one’s skills and interests. What makes them stand out is their quick response, personal attention, and genuine effort to help job seekers. It feels reassuring to know that there’s an organization committed to bridging the gap between NGOs and passionate professionals who want to make a difference.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to build a meaningful career in the social sector. 👍
